methodology.officialSourceSelection: Official regional inventory objects near the municipality centre, ranked for landmark specificity and category balance
methodology.sparseCityFallback: Coordinate-bearing Wikidata landmarks within the municipality hierarchy, queried only when fewer than 12 official candidates were available; a bounded 6 km Wikidata proximity query and then named OpenStreetMap features inside the exact municipality relation provide the final five-medal floor

sources.brusselsInventoryLimitation: The Brussels official inventory does not expose a comparable bulk point feed in this builder; Brussels municipalities use the bounded Wikidata fallback.
